Europe   Group tour   9 days, 6 nights

Eastern Europe Vista

Budapest, Vienna, Hallstatt, Salzburg, Cesky Krumlov and Prague.

Overview

Four capitals and two fairytale towns.

The Danube at Budapest, imperial Vienna, the lakeside village of Hallstatt, Mozart’s Salzburg, medieval Cesky Krumlov, and two nights in Prague.

Highlights

  • Danube River cruise in Budapest
  • Fisherman’s Bastion
  • Schönbrunn Palace
  • Hallstatt
  • Mozart’s Salzburg
  • Cesky Krumlov
  • Prague Castle
  • Charles Bridge and the Astronomical Clock

Departure dates

Group departures from Kuala Lumpur. Ask us which dates still have seats.

  • Feb 202718

Day by day

  1. Day01

    Kuala Lumpur to Budapest

    Overnight flight to Budapest.

  2. Day02

    BudapestL, D

    Matthias Church and Fisherman’s Bastion, with a drive past Buda Castle, the Chain Bridge, Andrássy Avenue and Heroes’ Square.

    Danube River cruise.

    StayBudapest

  3. Day03

    Budapest, Bratislava, ViennaB, D

    Bratislava. The castle and the old town square.

    On to Vienna.

    StayVienna

  4. Day04

    ViennaB, D

    Schönbrunn Palace, the Habsburg summer residence.

    St Stephen’s Cathedral, Kärntner Strasse, the Hofburg and the Belvedere gardens.

    Shopping at Parndorf Designer Outlet.

    StayVienna

  5. Day05

    Vienna, Hallstatt, SalzburgB, D

    Hallstatt, the UNESCO-listed village on its lake.

    Salzburg. Mirabell Palace and Gardens, Mozart’s birthplace, the cathedral and Mozartplatz.

    StaySalzburg

  6. Day06

    Salzburg, Cesky Krumlov, PragueB, L, D

    Cesky Krumlov, a UNESCO town wrapped around its castle on the Vltava.

    On to Prague.

    StayPrague

  7. Day07

    PragueB

    Prague Castle, St Vitus Cathedral, the Old Royal Palace and Golden Lane.

    Charles Bridge, the Old Town Square, the Astronomical Clock and Wenceslas Square.

    StayPrague

  8. Day08

    Prague to Kuala LumpurB

    Overnight flight home.

  9. Day09

    Arrive in Kuala Lumpur

    Welcome home.

The package

What’s included.

Booked through YSL. We handle your booking, documents and questions from start to finish.

Included

  • Return flights from Kuala Lumpur
  • Six nights in 4-star hotels or similar: Budapest 1, Vienna 2, Salzburg 1, Prague 2
  • 6 breakfasts, 2 lunches and 5 dinners
  • Danube cruise, Schönbrunn Palace and Prague Castle
  • One checked bag up to 20kg

Not included

  • Visa, travel insurance and tipping, unless stated
  • Meals not listed
